description: 土砂災害事件影像 [landslides and debris flows and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 農業部. 蒐集歷史影像照片，建立歷史影像照片應用程式介面(API)提供應用系統介接，提供之資料提供包括EventID(照片識別碼)、PhotoType(照片型態)、Lat(緯度)、Lng(經度)、County(縣市)、Town(鄉鎮)、Vill(村里)、 PhotoDate(照片拍攝時間)、PhotoAngle(拍攝角度)、Source(照片提供者... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 農業部. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-08-22 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
